in_marathi.name: Vikrant
in_marathi.long_meaning: Vikrant हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। In Sanskrit, 'Vikrant' is derived from the root words 'Vikr' meaning 'to conquer' and 'Ant' meaning 'direction' or 'place'. This name is a tribute to the powerful warriors and victorious rulers in Hindu mythology. Vikrant embodies the spirit of courage, strength, and leadership.
